value.rationale: Sharpness of a very recent supercongruence is a motivated mathematical invariant, not an arbitrary table: the exact prime-adic order decides whether the published modulus \(p^{2}\) is best possible. The result identifies and completely certifies the first two primes with an extra p factor, proves there are no others among smaller odd primes, proves that the extra factor stops at \(p^{3}\), and extends the finite witnesses to an unbounded truncation parameter. This finite exception threshold is chosen by the phenomenon, not an arbitrary number; it may guide searches for analogues of irregular-prime behavior. No broader global classification is claimed.
